name: New Era
verdict: Owned by New Era Cap, LLC, a family-owned (Koch) company with a significant ACON Investments stake. Nothing found.
note: Official Cap of LIV Golf and all 13 teams (livgolf.com/partners); appears on every team page. Rating note: family-owned by the Koch family (fourth-generation CEO Christopher H. Koch), first institutional investor ACON Investments holds a significant stake; NFL, NBA and MLB minority investors per ACON's 2022 continuation fund announcement (unsourced here beyond ACON's own releases). No state or state-fund owner identified.
